## Verdict: REJECT (one Critical checklist failure and two unmet acceptance criteria)

This PR is not ready to merge: one moved refusal test does not check why the query was refused, which acceptance criterion 7 requires, and one no-dialect test that relies on SQLite catalog names still has no MySQL counterpart, which criterion 6 requires.

Rule applied: rule 1 — a checklist FAIL at or above the threshold → REJECT

## Code Review Findings

### 🔴 Critical

- VC-101: FAIL (critical) — Every moved or added test that expects a refusal (`UnsafeSqlError`, `RlsError`, `PreflightError`, `RuleSetFileError`) asserts the refusal's reason, with `match=` or an assertion on the error's message or detail. A statement refused for an unrelated reason then fails the test. [tests/unit/test_mysql_runner.py:208] — fix the code, or have the issue author amend this criterion

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  Criterion 7 (read from criteria.json; it is a valid {criterion,text} list and carries criterion 7) requires every moved or added refusal test to assert the refusal's reason. Most do: the added test_mysql_runner.py:208 (match="database views are not supported"), test_metadata_bounds.py:43 (match="not supplied"), the moved test_rls_views.py cases (match="database views are not supported"), the added test_safety.py corpus entries (reason regexes), the added test_mysql_denylist_under_rules_refuses_before_a_real_runner (match="function 'sleep' is not allowed"), and the moved test_safety_rls.py cases at 456-567 (match= on each). Counterexample: tests/unit/test_safety_rls.py:517-525, `test_wrong_typed_dynamic_value_blocks`, is a moved test. The PR diff (hunk @@ -518,7 +520,7 @@, around diff.patch:3146-3153) changes its `dialect="sqlite"` to `dialect="mysql"`. It expects a refusal with a bare `with pytest.raises(RlsError):` and no `match=` and no assertion on the message or detail. A statement refused for an unrelated reason, for example a parse refusal or the relation refusal, would still pass it. That is the exact outcome criterion 7 says must fail the test. One moved refusal test lacking a reason assertion breaks the claim's 'every'. The claim therefore does not hold over its whole scope, even though the two sites in the verify_hint (test_mysql_runner.py:208 and test_metadata_bounds.py:43) do assert a reason. I did not audit every other bare `pytest.raises` in files the PR touched.
